field_text_formatted.value: I've been putting all of my modules on Alex Skrypnyk's Drupal Extension Scaffold, running Drupal's own CI templates on my own GitLab with GitHub beside it. Most of my time on this release went into the tests that pipeline runs: 9 test files at rc1, 36 now. That's what tells me the module still works when I come back to it after months on something else.
